newsitem.title: USA: Shell chief sees Saudi, Texaco U.S. merger in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Shell chief sees Saudi, Texaco U.S. merger in 1997.

text.p: The president of Shell Oil Company said Monday talks were progressing "very well" for merger of Shell Oil's, Texaco's and Saudi Arabia's Aramco U.S. refining and marketing operations.
"I hope we can reach a successful conclusion in the not too far distant future," Philip Carroll, attending the American Petroleum Institute's annual meeting, told Reuters.
Carroll said he hoped the companies would be able to conclude a letter of intent to put together the alliance "in a matter of weeks rather than months."
Carroll said that there would be many "crucial items to be negotiated" before they could reach a final agreement.
"I hope we would be able to put the entire thing together by the end of 1997, maybe even earlier," he said.
